title: Finance Executive
description:
Company Overview: Market Xcel is a leading provider of online market research services, specializing in gathering consumer insights for businesses worldwide. Our innovative approach and cutting-edge technology allow us to deliver high-quality data and actionable insights to our clients, empowering them to make informed decisions and drive business growth. Designation: Finance Executive 
 Website: https://www.market-xcel.com/
 Nature of Work: Full Time (Work from Office Sarita Vihar) About the Role 
 We are looking for a Finance Executive to support day-to-day accounting and finance operations, with a strong focus on project expense management, freelancer/vendor payments, bookkeeping, reconciliations, and statutory compliance. The role will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, verifying project-related transactions, coordinating with internal teams and freelancers, and ensuring timely completion of finance processes. Key Responsibilities 
 Project File & Expense Settlement: Review project expenses, verify supporting documents, reconcile advances, and ensure timely project file closure. Bank & Cash Book Entries: Record and maintain accurate daily bank and cash transactions in the accounting system. Bank Reconciliation: Perform regular bank reconciliations, identify discrepancies, and ensure timely resolution of unreconciled items. Freelancer Payment Verification: Verify freelancer payment sheets against project/raw data, check calculations and supporting details, and ensure payment accuracy. Freelancer Onboarding: Manage freelancer onboarding, verify required documents and bank details, and create/maintain freelancer accounts and master data. Finance Coordination & Controls: Coordinate with internal teams for pending documents/data and ensure compliance with defined finance processes and timelines. TDS Compliance: Calculate and deduct applicable TDS on vendor/freelancer payments, maintain TDS records. GST-related Activities: GST Invoice and input tax verification, GST reconciliation etc. Qualifications & Skills Graduate in B.Com (Hons.) or MBA (Finance) from a recognized institution. Experience – 3+ yrs Good understanding of bookkeeping, accounting entries, bank reconciliation, and financial documentation. Working knowledge of TDS, GST and basic tax computation. Strong proficiency in MS Excel, including data handling, reconciliation, and basic formulas. Good numerical and analytical skills with strong attention to detail. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with freelancers, vendors, and internal team

title: Manager - Shipment Reconciliation
description:
Roles and Responsibilities The Manager, Shipments Dispute Reconciliation, is responsible for leading the resolution of shipment- related disputes with clients. This role requires strong analytical skills to perform Loss vs. Revenue Analysis, excellent negotiation abilities to achieve favorable outcomes, and meticulous attention to detail to ensure timely and accurate reconciliation of client disputes, provisions, audits, and compliance. The manager will lead a multi-faceted team to resolve client lost and damaged disputes, analyze and mitigate financial losses, and ensure the accurate closure of all shipment-level disputes from the client end. This role is central to safeguarding the company's revenue and maintaining strong client relationships. 
 Client Dispute Resolution Leadership & Reporting 
 Monitor and reconcile daily, weekly, and monthly transactions between internal stakeholder & Clients. Lead and manage the end-to-end process of resolving all shipment-level disputes with clients, ensuring a high rate of successful and timely reconciliation. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding disputes. Utilize strong negotiation skills to reach mutually beneficial agreements while protecting the company's financial interests. Generate regular reports on dispute resolution metrics, including resolution rates, financial recoveries, and key trends. Present these findings to senior management. Conduct thorough Loss vs. Revenue Analysis for each dispute to determine the financial impact and support negotiation strategies. 
 Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate with finance, warehouse, operations, and clients to resolve discrepancies. Work closely with operations, sales, and finance teams to gather necessary information and align on dispute resolution strategies. 
 Process Improvement Identify gaps and improve automation and efficiency in reconciliation processes. Develop SOPs and policies to ensure robust minimizing the losses. Designing SOP for every client to minimize the losses for damage & TAT breach cases. 
 Team Leadership Supervise and mentor a team of specialists, providing guidance and training to improve their analytical and negotiation skills. Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop a team. 
 Audit & Compliance Prepare monthly reconciliation reports and summaries for management review. Support statutory and internal audits by providing necessary reconciliations and documentation. Ensure compliance with internal financial policies and external regulatory requirements.

title: OS Admin
description:
Role Overview The OS Administrator is responsible for installing, configuring, securing, and maintaining operating systems across servers and enterprise environments. The role ensures system stability, security, and performance by managing day-to-day operations, troubleshooting incidents, and supporting infrastructure upgrades. 
 Technical Skills Required Linux Administration Strong hands-on experience with RHEL/CentOS/Oracle Linux. User, process, memory, and file system management. Shell scripting and automation. Performance tuning and troubleshooting. Network and security administration in Linux environments. Oracle Database Administration Oracle Database installation, configuration, and patching. Backup and recovery using RMAN. Database performance monitoring and tuning. User, schema, and privilege management. Experience with Oracle HA/DR solutions is preferred. 
 System Administration Install, configure, and maintain Windows / Linux / Unix servers . Manage user accounts, permissions, and system access in compliance with policies. Apply OS patches, upgrades, and security updates on a regular schedule. Monitoring & Performance Monitor system performance, availability, and resource utilization. Conduct regular health checks and ensure compliance with SLAs. Troubleshoot OS-related issues and provide root cause analysis. Security & Compliance Implement and maintain system security (hardening, access control, vulnerability patching). Support audits and compliance requirements Maintain system backup, recovery, and disaster recovery readiness. Operations & Support Provide L2/L3 support for OS-related incidents. Automate routine tasks using scripts (Shell, PowerShell, Python). Maintain documentation of system configurations, SOPs, and changes. Collaboration Work closely with network, storage, and application teams for issue resolution. Support infrastructure projects, migrations, and capacity planning. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or related field. 35 years of experience in Linux / Windows / Unix administration . Strong knowledge of system performance tuning, patch management, and log analysis. Familiarity with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM). Understanding of security hardening, firewalls, and endpoint protection. Proficiency in scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python preferred). 
 Key Responsibilities Provide L2 support for Linux servers and Oracle database environments. Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents within defined SLAs. Perform installation, configuration, patching, and upgrades of Linux servers and Oracle databases . Monitor system and database performance and implement optimization measures. Manage backup, recovery, and disaster recovery operations using RMAN. Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and recommend preventive actions. Support change management, release activities, and maintenance windows. Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and vendor teams for issue resolution. Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, and technical knowledge repositories. Desired Candidate Profile 7-10 years of relevant experience in Linux and Oracle Database administration. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Experience supporting large-scale production environments. Ability to work in a 24x7 support environment and handle critical incidents. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skill Certifications such as RHCSA / RHCE, MCSA / MCSE, CompTIA Linux+, VMware VCP.

title: Senior US Accountant - End To End Accounting & Team Support
description:
About the Role: 
 We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Senior US Accountant who can independently manage the complete end-to-end accounting process for US-based clients. The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of US accounting principles, hands-on experience in finalizing books of accounts, preparing financial statements, and managing month-end closing activities. In addition to handling accounting responsibilities independently, the candidate should be capable of guiding junior accountants, resolving their day-to-day accounting queries, and reviewing their work to ensure accuracy and timely deliverables. Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End US Accounting Independently manage the complete accounting cycle for US-based clients. Handle bookkeeping, journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and adjusting entries. Perform general ledger maintenance and reconciliations. Manage bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations. Handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, and related accounting activities. Perform month-end and year-end closing activities. Finalize books of accounts and prepare accurate financial statements, including Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Statement, and Cash Flow Statement. Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies independently. 2. Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting Apply US GAAP principles in day-to-day accounting activities. Review financial transactions and ensure correct accounting treatment. Analyze general ledger balances and investigate discrepancies. Prepare and review financial reports and supporting schedules. Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of accounting assignments. 3. Team Guidance & Review Provide technical accounting guidance to junior accountants. Resolve accounting-related queries and explain appropriate accounting treatments. Review work prepared by junior team members and identify errors. Support junior accountants in understanding complex accounting transactions. Coordinate with the reporting manager regarding unresolved issues, work progress, and deadlines. 4. Client Accounting & Ownership Take ownership of assigned US client accounts. Independently manage accounting deliverables and deadlines. Identify issues proactively and communicate them to the reporting manager. Maintain accuracy and consistency across accounting records. Required Skills & Qualifications 36 years of relevant hands-on experience in US Accounting. Strong practical knowledge of end-to-end US accounting processes. Proven experience in month-end closing, book finalization, and financial statement preparation. Strong understanding of US GAAP and general ledger accounting. Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online and/or Xero. Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Ability to independently investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies. Ability to review and guide junior accountants. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Mandatory Eligibility Criteria Please apply only if you have relevant, practical experience in end-to-end US accounting. Candidates must have hands-on experience in managing the complete accounting cycle, including month-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, finalization of books, and financial statement preparation. Candidates whose experience is limited to Indian Accounting, basic bookkeeping, data entry, or only one accounting function such as AP/AR, without exposure to the complete US accounting cycle, will not be considered for this position. We request applicants to carefully review the mandatory requirements before applying. Why Join Accruon Ventures? Opportunity to work directly on US client accounting processes. Exposure to complete accounting cycles and complex transactions. Opportunity to take ownership of client assignments. Collaborative environment with opportunities to develop technical and team-management skills. If you have strong end-to-end US accounting experience and are confident in independently handling client accounts while supporting junior accountants, we encourage you to apply.

title: Manager - Finance & Accounts
description:
Role Purpose 
 The Manager Finance will lead the financial management of grants, business and support strong financial governance across Dharmalife Foundation and its group entities. 
 Grant financial management will be the key priority of the role. The Manager will oversee grant budgeting, fund allocation, expenditure monitoring, donor reporting, utilisation documentation and grant-specific audits. The role will work closely with programme and partnerships teams to ensure that financial plans, project activities and donor commitments remain aligned. 
 The position will also manage budgeting, accounting, statutory compliance, financial reporting, treasury, internal controls and audit coordination. The incumbent will provide leadership with accurate and timely financial information to support operational and strategic decisions. 
 Success in this role means that donor/stakeholder reports and statutory filings are submitted on time, financial records remain audit-ready, funds are used for approved purposes, cash requirements are anticipated, and management receives reliable financial information. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Financial Planning, Budgeting and Business Finance Lead the annual budgeting and periodic forecasting processes across functions, programmes and entities. Consolidate programme, departmental and grant budgets into an organisation-wide financial plan. Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets and provide monthly variance analysis with clear explanations and corrective actions. Develop financial models and scenario analyses for new programmes, partnerships, geographies and organisational initiatives. Support cost planning, resource allocation and financial evaluation of new proposals. Provide practical financial advice to programme and functional leaders. Support leadership in assessing financial risks, funding gaps and organisational sustainability. 
 2. Grant Financial Management and Donor Compliance Manage the financial lifecycle of grants from proposal development and budget preparation through implementation, reporting, audit and closure. Review grant agreements and translate financial conditions into budgets, controls, reporting calendars and responsibility matrices. Maintain grant-wise budgets, expenditure records, fund balances, reporting deadlines and supporting documentation. Monitor expenditure against approved budgets and programme plans and identify underspending, overspending or ineligible expenditure at an early stage. Coordinate with programme teams to prepare forecasts, budget revisions and fund-utilisation plans. Prepare accurate and timely donor financial reports, utilisation statements and supporting schedules. Maintain donor-specific accounting and reporting records in accordance with grant conditions. Coordinate grant-specific audits and ensure timely resolution of observations and audit findings. Ensure that grant expenditure complies with donor conditions, internal policies and applicable statutory requirements. 
 3. Accounting, Financial Reporting and Statutory Compliance Oversee day-to-day accounting and ensure that financial transactions are recorded accurately, completely and within the appropriate period. Ensure timely completion of bank, vendor, employee advance, grant and inter-entity reconciliations. Maintain accurate ledgers, schedules and supporting documentation across the group entities. Ensure timely compliance with applicable requirements relating to TDS, GST, income tax, FCRA, CSR and other regulatory frameworks. Coordinate the monthly, quarterly and annual closure of accounts. Prepare financial statements, management reports and schedules required for statutory, internal and donor audits. Liaise with auditors, consultants and statutory authorities and ensure timely closure of observations. Maintain financial records in an audit-ready condition. 
 4. Treasury, Cash Flow and Financial Controls Prepare and regularly update organisational and grant-wise cash-flow forecasts. Monitor liquidity and provide advance visibility of funding requirements, projected shortfalls and restricted fund balances. Manage banking relationships, authorised fund transfers and related documentation. Ensure that funds are allocated and used in accordance with approved budgets and grant restrictions. Design, document and implement financial policies, standard operating procedures and approval controls. Maintain appropriate segregation of duties and maker-checker controls. Conduct periodic financial-risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures. Strengthen controls relating to payments, advances, procurement, reimbursements, assets and field expenditure. Promptly escalate suspected irregularities, control failures or potential misuse of funds. 
 5. Financial Reporting, MIS and Decision Support Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial reports for management review. Develop clear dashboards covering grants, budgets, cash flow, receivables, payables, statutory compliance and audit status. Provide accurate financial information and analysis for leadership and Board reviews. Present significant variances, risks, funding gaps and decisions required in a concise and actionable format. Maintain a consolidated calendar of donor reports, audits, statutory filings and other financial obligations. Improve the quality and timeliness of financial information through appropriate systems, automation and standardisation. 
 6. Team Leadership and Financial Capability Guide, supervise and develop members of the Finance team and field-based finance personnel. Allocate responsibilities clearly and establish review and accountability mechanisms. Build the financial capability of programme, operations and partnership teams through practical training and guidance. Help non-finance colleagues understand budgets, grant conditions, supporting-document requirements and financial controls. Promote a culture of accuracy, accountability, transparency and timely closure. Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, systems and team effectiveness. 
 Key Measures of Success Performance will be assessed through indicators such as: Donor financial reports submitted accurately and within agreed timelines Grant expenditure aligned with approved budgets and donor conditions Timely identification and resolution of budget variances and funding gaps Monthly and annual accounts closed according to the agreed calendar Statutory filings and audits completed on time Reconciliations completed with minimal unresolved items Reliable cash-flow forecasts and sufficient visibility of operational liquidity Audit observations and control gaps closed within agreed timelines Accurate and decision-useful MIS provided to leadership Improved financial understanding and compliance among programme and field teams Candidate Profile 
 Education B. Com/M. Com with MBA (Finance) Preference to Qualified Chartered Accountant/ Cost Accountant (ICWA) 
 Experience Seven to Ten years of relevant post-qualification experience in finance, accounting, audit, grant management or business finance. Candidates should have demonstrated experience in managing institutional grants, donor reporting and audit requirements. Experience in a nonprofit, Section 8 company, development-sector organisation, corporate foundation or multi-entity environment would be an advantage. 
 Skills and Attributes Strong understanding of grant budgeting, utilisation monitoring. Business finance and donor financial reporting Sound knowledge of accounting standards, taxation and statutory compliance Working knowledge of applicable FCRA and CSR requirements Experience in budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling and variance analysis Strong internal-control and risk-management orientation Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel Working experience with Tally, ERP or comparable financial systems Ability to present complex financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills High standards of accuracy, integrity, confidentiality and accountability Ability to balance detailed financial review with broader organisational priorities Willingness to travel occasionally to programme and field locations 
 Why Join Dharmalife Lead grant finance and financial governance within a purpose-driven organisation working at significant rural scale. Work across diverse programmes supported by institutional funders, government bodies and corporate partners. Strengthen financial systems that directly support women’s livelihoods and community impact. Gain exposure to multi-entity finance, donor management, field operations and organisational strategy. Work with multidisciplinary teams committed to inclusive and sustainable development.

title: Account Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities Oversee the organisations day-to-day accounting operations, including general ledger, bank reconciliation, accounts payable, accounts receivable and financial record maintenance. Prepare and review monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements. Develop annual organisational budgets in consultation with management. Prepare project-wise, department-wise and centre-wise budgets, forecasts and cash flow projections. Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets, analyse variances and recommend corrective measures. Ensure effective financial planning, cost control and optimal utilisation of organisational resources. Ensure the accounts team works professionally by establishing clear responsibilities, standardising processes, maintaining accountability, and promoting discipline, efficiency and a collaborative work environment. Ensure compliance with applicable provisions of the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA), FCRA Rules and related regulatory requirements. Monitor foreign contribution receipts, utilisation, accounting, bank transactions and project-wise expenditure in accordance with applicable regulations. Ensure timely preparation and filing of applicable FCRA returns, including Form FC-4, and maintain all prescribed records and supporting documentation. Monitor compliance with applicable FCRA provisions relating to foreign contribution utilisation, administrative expenditure and other regulatory restrictions. Ensure compliance with applicable Income Tax provisions, including TDS/TCS, advance tax, income tax returns and other relevant filings. Oversee GST compliance, including applicability assessments, return filing, reconciliations, input tax credit review and documentation, wherever applicable. Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and ensure timely payment of taxes, statutory dues and filing of returns. Coordinate with tax consultants, auditors and relevant authorities regarding assessments, notices, audits and compliance matters. Monitor donor grants, donations and restricted funds against approved budgets, project objectives and donor-specific conditions. Prepare donor-wise and project-wise fund utilisation statements, utilisation certificates, expenditure statements and financial reports. Ensure timely submission of financial reports and utilisation certificates to donors, funding agencies and other relevant stakeholders. Verify project expenditure against approved budgets and ensure adequate supporting documentation, approvals, invoices and vouchers are maintained. Track grant balances, unspent funds, expenditure commitments and donor reporting deadlines. Coordinate with programme teams and departmental heads to collect expenditure data and supporting documents for donor reporting. Coordinate statutory, internal, donor and other applicable audits and ensure timely availability of financial records and audit schedules. Review audit observations, facilitate their resolution and implement appropriate corrective measures in coordination with management. Establish and strengthen internal financial controls, accounting procedures and financial documentation systems. Review payment requests, expense claims, employee advances and settlements to ensure compliance with approved policies and procedures. Prepare periodic financial dashboards, management reports and financial analyses to support informed decision-making. Identify financial risks, discrepancies and opportunities to improve financial efficiency and compliance. Supervise and guide the accounts team, ensuring accuracy, accountability and timely completion of assigned responsibilities. Coordinate with internal departments and organisational centres to ensure consistent financial reporting and adherence to financial procedures. Maintain accurate, organised and confidential financial records and promote transparency and accountability in all financial operations.

Key Skills: Budgeting,General accounting,Accounting operations,Taxation,Tally,Accounts receivable,Statutory,Income tax

title: National Collection Manager
description:
About MobiKwik 
MobiKwik is India's leading digital banking platform, offering a wide range of financial products for both consumers and merchants - including payments, digital credit, and investments. As a technology-first company, it leverages big data analytics and deep data science (including machine learning) to continuously delight users and merchants on its platform. The Company's mission is to build world-class financial products for Bharat! 
Founded in 2009 by Bipin Preet Singh and Upasana Taku, MobiKwik has 140 million+ registered users across a 3.7 million strong merchant network. With 40 million credit pre-approved users, MobiKwik is focused on providing India's underserved population their first access to credit -democratising financial services for a billion Indians. 
 Role Overview 
 Position: Senior Collections Manager (NCM) Location: Gurgaon Department: Collections & Recovery 
As Senior Collections Manager at MobiKwik, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimising the collections process for our Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) and digital lending portfolio. You will drive timely recovery of outstanding balances while upholding customer dignity and ensuring strict compliance with RBI's Fair Practices Code and relevant regulatory guidelines. The role demands a strategic mindset, strong leadership capabilities, and an unwavering commitment to ethical collections conduct. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Collections Strategy & Portfolio Management 
 Develop and implement comprehensive collections strategies aligned with company goals and RBI regulatory requirements. Analyse portfolio performance, bucket-wise delinquency trends, and market conditions to identify opportunities for improving collections efficiency. Collaborate with senior management to set achievable recovery targets and build data-driven action plans. Define segmentation-based strategies for different borrower profiles - MSMEs, merchants, digital-first customers across DPD buckets (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+). 2. Team Leadership & Performance Management 
 Lead, mentor, and coach a team of collection executives and field agents to optimise individual and team performance. Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide structured feedback, and identify training needs - including mandatory Fair Practices training. Foster a culture of accountability, ethical conduct, and continuous improvement within the collections department. Ensure all team members are trained on RBI's Code of Conduct for recovery agents before deployment. 3. Operations Management 
 Oversee day-to-day collections operations including outbound dialling, digital collection nudges, field visits, payment processing, and account reconciliation. Implement robust processes and controls to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, company policies, and recovery agent guidelines. Leverage technology, diallers, and data analytics to streamline workflows, improve RPC rates, and enhance collections outcomes. Manage vendor/agency relationships for outsourced collections, ensuring contractual compliance and RBI-prescribed conduct standards. 4. Customer Engagement & Grievance Management 
 Proactively engage with borrowers to understand their financial situations, communicate empathetically, and negotiate feasible repayment arrangements. Handle escalated customer inquiries and complaints with professionalism, ensuring resolution within timelines prescribed under RBI's Integrated Ombudsman Scheme. Maintain and periodically review a documented Customer Grievance Redressal mechanism aligned with RBI Fair Practices Code. Ensure all borrower communication is conducted only during permissible hours (8 AM to 7 PM) as per RBI guidelines, without any form of harassment or intimidation. 5. Reporting, Analytics & Risk Controls 
 Track and report KPIs including collection efficiency ratio, RPC rate, roll rates, resolution rate, and recovery rate across DPD buckets. Prepare regular MIS reports and presentations for senior management, highlighting performance trends and areas for optimisation. Conduct root cause analysis of delinquent accounts and implement corrective actions to minimise future losses. Ensure maintenance of call recordings and field visit logs for regulatory audit readiness. 
 Code of Conduct RBI Compliance Expectations 
As a Senior Collections Manager at a regulated NBFC/Fintech, adherence to the RBI's prescribed Code of Conduct for recovery agents is a non-negotiable condition of employment. The incumbent is expected to:
 Ensure that all recovery agents (internal and outsourced) are duly trained and certified before being deployed for collections, in accordance with RBI's Recovery Agent Guidelines. Maintain a list of authorised recovery agents and share it with the company's Compliance and Nodal Officer; ensure the list is updated with every change. Ensure agents carry and present a duly authorised identity card at all times during field visits. Prohibit any recovery practice that amounts to harassment, intimidation, threats, or use of abusive language whether in person, via call, SMS, email, or any digital channel. Ensure all borrower communication occurs only within RBI-prescribed hours (8 AM - 7 PM) unless the borrower explicitly consents otherwise; no exceptions. Prohibit contact with any person other than the borrower or their authorised representative for recovery purposes, except for tracing purposes and strictly within legal bounds. Ensure borrowers are provided with a clear notice before any recovery action, specifying the amount due, the consequences of non-payment, and the name and contact details of the recovery agent. Maintain detailed records of all collection interactions calls, visits, messages for a minimum period as specified by RBI, to facilitate audit and grievance resolution. Ensure that all collection-related communications (notices, settlement letters, receipts) are factually accurate, clearly worded, and free from misleading statements. Prohibit engagement of any recovery agent who has been found guilty of any offence involving moral turpitude or has been blacklisted by any regulated financial entity. Uphold borrower privacy no disclosure of personal financial information to unauthorised third parties, family members, or employers without explicit borrower consent. Report any violations of the Code of Conduct by agents or staff immediately to the Compliance Officer and ensure appropriate disciplinary action. Cooperate fully with RBI inspections, audits, or inquiries related to collections practices, and ensure timely submission of required data and documents. Support the implementation and periodic review of the company's Board-approved Fair Practices Code, ensuring collections policies remain aligned with evolving RBI circulars. 
 Note: Non-compliance with RBI's Code of Conduct for Recovery Agents may attract regulatory penalties for the organisation and will be treated as a serious disciplinary matter for the incumbent. 
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience & Qualifications 
 10 - 15 years of experience in collections management, preferably within fintech, NBFC, or banking (digital lending, MCA, or SME credit preferred). Proven track record of leading large collections teams (50+ headcount) and consistently achieving recovery targets in a high-volume environment. Graduate/Postgraduate in Business, Finance, or related field; MBA preferred. Familiarity with RBI's regulatory framework: Fair Practices Code, FLDG guidelines, Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, and Recovery Agent Certification requirements. Skills & Competencies 
 Deep understanding of collections regulations, compliance requirements, and industry best practices in the Indian lending ecosystem. Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills. Ability to analyse complex delinquency data, derive actionable insights, and make data-driven decisions. Experience with collections technology platforms - diallers, CRMs, LMS integration, and digital nudge tools. High integrity with a demonstrated commitment to ethical collections practices and regulatory compliance. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders - legal, risk, operations, and technology teams - with clarity and purpose. Why MobiKwik? 
 Be part of India's digital lending story at scale - 40 million pre-approved credit customers. Work in a fast-paced, data-first environment with strong cross-functional collaboration. Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives. A leadership role with direct impact on portfolio quality and business outcomes. Exposure to the full spectrum of fintech collectionsn- digital nudges, field operations, legal, and policy.

 Take ownership of existing reconciliation and accounting processes and ensure they are followed consistently. Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly activities to ensure timely completion and accurate reporting. Track pending reconciliations, unidentified receipts, outstanding balances, and unresolved discrepancies until closure. Review existing working files, trackers, and reports to ensure they are updated regularly and reflect the correct status. Identify process gaps, recurring errors, and areas where controls or working methods can be improved. Ensure proper documentation, standardisation, and continuity of processes, reducing dependency on individual employees. Maintain professional communication while resolving financial discrepancies and payment-related queries. 6. MIS & Reporting 
 Prepare weekly and monthly reconciliation reports, customer/vendor outstanding statements, balance confirmation records, and discrepancy reports. Maintain trackers for pending items, ageing balances, marketplace claims, and unresolved differences. Provide periodic updates to the reporting manager on reconciliation status, significant discrepancies, and pending closures. Ensure that reports are accurate, complete, and submitted within agreed timelines. Required Qualifications & Experience

Practical experience in marketplace reconciliation for Amazon, Flipkart, or similar e-commerce platforms. Experience handling traditional retail, wholesale, distributor, and vendor accounts. Strong working knowledge of Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime. Advanced working knowledge of MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF/SUMIFS, data validation, and reconciliation techniques. description:
Indus Parking Services (IPS) is an emerging parking enforcement company based in the heart of Gurugram, India. title: Senior Staff Accountant
description:
Job Summary 
 Provides management with accurate financial information through accounting, reconciliations, inventory and cost accounting, and financial reporting. Supports the Financial Controller in monthly closing, audits, statutory compliance, budgeting, forecasting, and maintaining internal financial controls. The role covers general accounting, manufacturing accounting, and India-specific statutory compliance activities. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 General Accounting and Financial Reporting 
 Prepare journal entries and maintain general ledger accounts. Coordinate monthly financial closing activities. Reconcile balance sheet accounts and prepare account analyses and supporting schedules. Perform bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies. Reconcile intercompany accounts with affiliated companies. Monitor accounts payable activities and perform vendor reconciliations. Review employee expense reports and supporting documentation. Maintain accurate accounting records and financial documentation. Maintain fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules. Assist in preparing budgets, forecasts, and financial reports. Support the implementation and maintenance of internal financial controls. Assist with internal and external audits and respond to auditor requests. Research accounting issues and recommend appropriate solutions.

Assist with statutory audit schedules and documentation. Support compliance reporting related to Provident Fund (PF), Employees' State Insurance (ESI), Professional Tax, and other payroll-related statutory requirements. Maintain documentation required for tax and regulatory filings. Maintain records and documentation related to applicable RBI compliance requirements. Assist with transfer pricing schedules and intercompany documentation. Support the preparation of annual statutory financial statements.

description:
Job Summary 
 As a Senior Financial Analyst within Advanced Srgery FPA team, you will support financial planning, forecasting, performance reporting and decision support for the business. You will partner with regional, local and corporate finance teams to consolidate financial outlooks, identify performance drivers and risks, and translate complex financial information into clear insights for senior leadership. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Consolidate financial and business insights and prepare high-quality materials for monthly business reviews, forecasts and the annual operating plan, enabling effective discussions and decisions by the leadership team. Coordinate and consolidate monthly sales outlooks from all commercial regions across the Mid-month, WD-4 and PNS cycles; challenge assumptions, identify changes and ensure a clear, aligned global view. Partner closely with in-country business partners and finance teams to review projections, budgets and historical results, challenge key assumptions and improve the quality of financial outlooks. Load planning information into the financial systems (PlanIT) during every forecast process and conduct data validation checks to ensure accuracy. Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of the monthly reports, forecasts, and the annual budget / strategic plan preparation. Deliver accurate and timely monthly management reporting, including analysis of actual results versus budget and forecast, clear explanations of key drivers, and follow-up with PL and cost-centre owners on risks and opportunities. Partner with regional, local and corporate FPA teams, as well as commercial, manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders, to translate financial analysis into actionable recommendations and support decisions aligned with strategic objectives. Identify, assess and escalate material business and operational risks and opportunities, providing Finance leadership with timely analysis and recommended actions. Perform strategic and ad hoc financial analysis to evaluate business performance, investigate key drivers and develop recommendations that support management decision-making. Update process flows, operating manuals, training guides, and standard operating procedures, as needed. Drive continuous improvement across FPA reporting and planning processes by simplifying workflows, strengthening controls, improving data quality and supporting the implementation of finance systems, processes and policies. Liaise with the FPA Global Delivery Center (GDC) and other cross-functional leads to support the creation of budgets, forecasts and management reports, while ensuring compliance with all quality / control requirements.

 . Role Overview We are seeking a highly accomplished and result-oriented Senior Manager – Finance & Accounts to lead the Finance & Accounts function at our Head Office in New Delhi. The role will be responsible for driving financial strategy, overseeing accounting operations, ensuring statutory and regulatory compliance, strengthening internal controls, managing treasury and working capital, and supporting senior management in financial planning and business decision-making across the Group. The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership capabilities, sound commercial acumen, and extensive experience in financial management, taxation, audit, budgeting, and ERP systems. Demonstrated experience in leading and mentoring a team of 7–10 Accounts Officers/Accountants. . Experience Minimum 12 years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably in manufacturing and/or service industries. Proven experience in independently handling finance and accounting functions of medium to large business organizations. . Desired Skill Set Strong expertise in financial accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and business finance. Thorough knowledge of the Companies Act, Accounting Standards, GST, Income Tax, TDS, Costing, and other statutory compliances. Strong exposure to treasury management, banking operations, cash flow management, and working capital optimization. Experience in ERP-based financial systems, with advanced proficiency in MS Excel and MIS reporting. Ability to analyze financial data, identify business risks, and recommend strategic financial solutions. Strong leadership, decision-making, analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Excellent interpersonal, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management abilities. High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accuracy, and professional ethics. . Additional Preferences Experience working with diversified business groups will be an advantage. Exposure to financial markets, investment entities, NBFCs, or family offices will be preferred. Experience in implementing process improvements, automation initiatives, ERP enhancements, and AI-enabled finance solutions. Ability to work closely with promoters, Directors, CXOs, auditors, bankers, and regulatory authorities. . Key Responsibilities A. Financial Leadership & Reporting Lead the overall Finance & Accounts function across the Group. Ensure timely finalization of monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and annual financial statements. Review financial performance, profitability, cash flow, fund flow, and management reports. Present meaningful financial insights and analytical reports to senior management for strategic decision-making. B. Taxation & Regulatory Compliance Ensure complete compliance with all direct and indirect tax laws, including GST, Income Tax, TDS, and other statutory requirements. Review tax planning strategies, assessments, notices, appeals, and litigations. Coordinate with statutory auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Cost Management Lead annual budgeting, financial forecasting, and long-term business planning. Monitor budget utilization and provide variance analysis with corrective recommendations. Drive cost optimization initiatives across business operations while maintaining financial discipline. Support business expansion, investment evaluation, and capital expenditure planning. D. Treasury & Working Capital Management Manage treasury operations, banking relationships, fund management, and liquidity planning. Monitor working capital, receivables, payables, inventory levels, and cash flow. Coordinate with financial institutions regarding banking facilities, documentation, and compliance. E. Team Leadership & Business Partnering Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Accounts Officers and finance professionals. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence. Collaborate closely with business heads and functional teams to support commercial decisions. Provide strategic financial advice and support to Directors and senior management to achieve organizational objectives. F. Internal Controls, ERP & Process Improvement Strengthen internal financial controls, accounting policies, SOPs, and governance frameworks. Drive ERP optimization, automation, digital finance initiatives, and AI-enabled reporting processes. Identify opportunities for improving operational efficiency and financial controls. G. Audit, Risk Management & Corporate Governance Lead statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, and due diligence assignments. Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions. Identify financial and compliance risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.

Verify commission, logistics charges, promotional deductions, penalties, TCS, TDS, and other marketplace deductions. Reconcile payment gateway collections and ensure accurate recording of receipts. Identify short payments, excess deductions, duplicate deductions, and settlement mismatches, and coordinate for timely resolution. 3. E-Commerce Platform Management Handle receivables and reconciliations for platforms such as Myntra, Ajio, Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa Fashion, and the company's D2C website, as applicable. Download and analyse settlement reports, sales reports, return reports, and payment statements from marketplace portals. Highlight overdue payments, unresolved deductions, and potential revenue leakages to the reporting manager. Support month-end closing and provide accurate receivables data for financial reporting. 5. Coordination & Issue Resolution Coordinate with marketplace finance teams, key account managers, and seller support teams to resolve payment issues. Work closely with internal E-Commerce, Sales, Customer Service, and Finance teams to resolve discrepancies related to returns, refunds, and settlements. Maintain supporting documentation for claims, debit notes, credit notes, and payment disputes. Follow up on claims and ensure timely recovery of disputed amounts. 6. Compliance & Process Improvement Ensure accurate accounting and documentation in accordance with company policies. Support GST/TDS/TCS reconciliations and statutory compliance requirements. Assist with internal and statutory audits by providing relevant reconciliations and supporting documents. Experience with ERP/accounting systems such as SAP, Oracle, Tally, or similar platforms is preferred. Key Skills Strong analytical and numerical skills. High attention to detail and accuracy. Excellent follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to investigate discrepancies and drive timely closure. Strong ownership of collections and reconciliation activities. Ability to manage multiple platforms and deadlines simultaneously. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely completion of marketplace and payment gateway reconciliations. Reduction in overdue receivables and outstanding settlement amounts. Timely identification and recovery of short payments and excess deductions. Accuracy of accounts receivable ageing and MIS reports. Timely closure of marketplace claims and payment disputes. Timely completion of month-end reconciliations. description:

Backed by leading VC firms like Powerhouse Ventures and GSF, and having recently raised pre series A funding, we are growing rapidly and setting the stage for the next phase of scale.We specialize in curated leisure travel experiences across 30+ global destinations, combining deep human expertise with a bold vision of building cutting-edge AI and technology that will transform how Indians plan and experience their holidays.Recognized as the Emerging Holiday Tech Company at the India Travel Awards 2023, we ve also partnered with international tourism boards to bring world-class experiences to Indian travelers.At our core, we are a fun, performance-driven workplace on a mission to build the next big thing in travel - making holiday planning faster, smarter, and unforgettable. 
 Role Overview The Ticketing Executive (FIT / Groups) is responsible for sourcing, booking, and issuing air tickets for individual FIT travellers through GDS and B2B portals and airline consolidator systems. This is a high-volume, detail-intensive role requiring strong command of B2B platforms, fare comparison across systems, strong GDS proficiency, and the ability and the discipline to process bookings accurately within cost and timeline constraints set by the internal process. 
 Key responsibilities Search, book, and issue domestic and international air tickets via GDS (Amadeus / Galileo / Sabre) and airline portals, ensuring best available fares within approved budgets. Receive confirmed FIT booking briefs from the sales / ops team and execute air ticket searches across B2B portals to identify the best available fare matching the itinerary routing, travel dates, and class. Compare fares across multiple B2B systems simultaneously to ensure the most cost-effective option is selected without compromising on schedule suitability for the guest. Book and issue tickets on approved B2B portals after internal fare approval; maintain booking within the portal-specified ticket time limit to avoid auto-cancellation. Verify passenger details meticulously - name as per passport, DOB for infants / seniors, passport number and expiry - before issuance to eliminate name mismatch or documentation errors. Track all live PNRs for schedule changes, airline-initiated cancellations, or waitlist clearances; communicate proactively to the ops team and arrange alternatives if needed. Process voluntary changes (date change, routing change, upgrades) and involuntary changes (IRROPs) through the B2B portal or directly with the airline, applying fare rules correctly. Handle refund and reissuance requests through the portal; track credit shell validity and ensure timely utilisation or refund as per airline policy. Reconcile portal wallet / credit balances and flag low-balance alerts to the finance team in advance of high-volume booking periods. Maintain a daily booking log in the internal MIS tracker - covering booking reference, airline, PNR, fare paid, portal used, and ticket status - for QC and accounts reconciliation. Requirements 3-5 years of ticketing experience in a travel agency, OTA, or tour operator environment. Hands-on proficiency in at least one major GDS (Amadeus strongly preferred); IATA certification a plus. Demonstrated experience with major B2B air consolidator platform - TripJack, TBO, My Partner, FD King or equivalent. Sound knowledge of IATA fare construction rules, airline fare families, reissuance penalties, and BSP reporting. Familiarity with both LCC portals (IndiGo, SpiceJet, Air Arabia etc.) and full-service carrier inventory management. Experience handling group ticketing, including name changes, group deposits, and bulk reissuances. Strong attention to detail - zero tolerance for name mismatches, sector errors, or missed time limits. Ability to work under pressure with high accuracy during peak booking seasons and last-minute emergencies. 
 Required Skills Analytics MS EXCEL

title: India Financial Controller
description:
Summary 
 Directs the financial affairs of the India organization and prepares financial analyses of operations, including interim and annual financial statements with supporting schedules, for the guidance of management. The India Financial Controller is responsible for the company's financial reporting, accounting policies, internal controls, tax compliance, statutory reporting, audit coordination, fixed asset management, budgeting, and forecasting activities. The position provides leadership to the accounting function while serving as a key business partner to plant leadership and corporate finance. 
 Essential Functions, Duties, and Responsibilities 
 The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to business needs. Serve as a business partner to the Plant Manager and leadership team. Oversee the Accounting Department to ensure the accurate and timely dissemination of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting. Direct the monthly close process and ensure compliance with corporate reporting requirements. Review account reconciliations, journal entries, and financial analyses prepared by accounting staff. Establish and maintain systems and controls that verify the integrity of accounting systems, processes, and financial data. Maintain the integrity of the company's accounting records and financial reporting systems. Coordinate and direct the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and cash flow projections. Analyze operating results and communicate significant variances and business trends to management. Oversee fixed asset accounting, capitalization policies, depreciation calculations, and asset verification activities. Lead statutory audits, tax audits, internal audits, and corporate audit requirements. Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, banks, and regulatory agencies. Ensure compliance with all applicable accounting standards and company policies. Support management with financial modeling, profitability analysis, and strategic decision-making. Participate in special projects and prepare financial analyses as requested by management. 
 India-Specific Statutory and Compliance Responsibilities 
 Ensure compliance with Companies Act requirements applicable to the India entity. Oversee GST compliance, filings, reconciliations, assessments, and refund processes. Ensure timely filing of direct tax returns and compliance with income tax regulations. Review and oversee TDS calculations, filings, payments, and reconciliations. Coordinate transfer pricing documentation and compliance requirements. Ensure compliance with RBI requirements related to foreign transactions, intercompany transactions, and remittances, when applicable. Oversee statutory payroll compliance, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, and other applicable regulations. Coordinate annual statutory financial statement preparation and local regulatory filings. Monitor changes in Indian tax, labor, and corporate regulations and implement necessary process updates. Maintain relationships with external consultants, auditors, and government authorities. Other Duties and Responsibilities Accomplish all tasks as appropriately assigned or requested. Supervisory Responsibilities Direct and manage the Accounting Department. Directly supervise the Senior Staff Accountant. Provide oversight and support to the Accounts Receivable Accountant. Develop and mentor finance team members. 
 Position Type and Required Hours of Work This is a full-time position. Occasional travel may be required. The position requires regular on-site presence at the assigned facility. 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 8+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience. Strong knowledge of financial reporting and internal controls. Strong knowledge of Indian direct and indirect tax regulations. Experience managing audits and statutory compliance. Manufacturing accounting experience. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities. 
 Preferred Qualifications Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification. NetSuite experience. Prior experience in a manufacturing environment. Experience working within a multinational organization.

title: Manager Finance
description:
Job Summary 
 The Commercial and Retail Finance Manager is responsible for comprehensive financial management of commercial and retail real estate portfolios, including financial planning, analysis, reporting, invoice generation, CAM reconciliations, and budgeting. This role provides strategic financial insight to support business decisions, optimize portfolio performance, and ensure accurate financial operations across property management. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Invoice Generation Accounts Receivable Management Generate and issue monthly tenant invoices for base rent, CAM charges, property taxes, insurance, and other recoverable expenses. Prepare and distribute quarterly or annual CAM estimate bills and reconciliation statements. Process lease escalations, percentage rent calculations, and special billing requirements. Monitor accounts receivable aging and coordinate collection efforts with property management teams. Reconcile tenant payments and resolve billing discrepancies. Maintain accurate tenant billing records and ensure compliance with lease terms. CAM (Common Area Maintenance) Management Administer CAM programs including calculation of tenant pro-rata shares based on lease terms and square footage. Prepare annual CAM budgets and estimate bills for distribution to tenants. Conduct detailed annual CAM reconciliations comparing actual expenses to billed estimates. Generate tenant-specific reconciliation statements showing overages or refunds due. Review and allocate operating expenses to appropriate CAM pools (common area, HVAC, parking, etc.). Ensure compliance with lease-specific CAM provisions, caps, and exclusions. Handle tenant CAM audits and respond to inquiries regarding expense allocations. Track and manage CAM over/under collections and adjust future billings accordingly. Budgeting Forecasting Lead the annual budgeting process for assigned commercial and retail properties, collaborating with property management teams. Develop detailed operating and capital budgets including revenue projections, operating expenses, CAM recoveries, and capital expenditures. Create quarterly reforecasts reflecting current market conditions, leasing activity, and operational changes. Analyze historical trends and market data to establish realistic budget assumptions. Present budget proposals to senior management and property owners for approval. Monitor budget performance throughout the year and provide variance explanations. Prepare rolling 12-month forecasts to support cash flow planning and strategic decision-making. Financial Planning Analysis Conduct variance analysis comparing actual performance to budgets, forecasts, and prior periods. Prepare financial models to evaluate investment opportunities, lease transactions, and capital projects. Monitor key performance indicators including NOI, occupancy rates, rent collections, operating expense ratios, and recovery percentages. Analyze lease structures and their financial impact on property cash flow. Identify opportunities to improve revenue collection and expense management. Financial Reporting Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements for property portfolios. Generate management reports highlighting financial performance, trends, and actionable insights. Produce owner reports with detailed variance explanations and supporting schedules. Present financial results to senior leadership, property owners, and stakeholders. Track and report on tenant rent rolls, lease expirations, and renewal activity. Ensure timely and accurate reporting in compliance with GAAP and company policies. Property Operations Support Partner with property management teams to optimize revenue and control operating expenses. Review and approve operating expense invoices and code to appropriate accounts. Support vendor contract negotiations by analyzing cost structures and payment terms. Analyze lease agreements for billing requirements, escalations, and recovery provisions. Coordinate with leasing teams on financial aspects of lease negotiations and tenant concessions. Support capital project planning with financial analysis and budget tracking. Team Collaboration Work cross-functionally with asset management, leasing, property management, and corporate finance teams. Mentor junior finance staff on billing processes, CAM procedures, and financial analysis. Build strong relationships with property teams to understand operational drivers of financial performance. Collaborate with accounts payable teams to ensure proper expense coding and allocation. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Required: Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, Real Estate, or related field. 5-7 years of progressive finance experience in commercial real estate property management. Strong knowledge of commercial lease structures, CAM calculations, and recovery methodologies. Demonstrated expertise in tenant billing, invoice generation, and accounts receivable management. Proven experience managing annual budgeting and CAM reconciliation processes. Advanced Excel skills including financial modeling, pivot tables, and complex formulas. Proficiency with property management systems (Yardi, MRI, or similar) and accounting software. Understanding of GAAP, real estate accounting principles, and lease accounting standards. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills for tenant and stakeholder interactions. Ability to manage multiple properties and priorities simultaneously while meeting deadlines. Preferred: CPA, CFA, or relevant professional certification. Experience with both commercial office and retail property types. Knowledge of percentage rent calculations and gross-up provisions. Familiarity with tenant improvement allowances and lease incentive accounting. Experience supporting acquisitions, dispositions, or property transitions. Background in lease administration and critical date tracking. 
 
 Technical Competencies 
 Expert knowledge of CAM allocation methodologies and industry best practices. Proficiency in lease abstract interpretation and billing requirement identification. Strong understanding of operating expense categories and allocation principles. Experience with recoverable versus non-recoverable expense classification. Ability to prepare detailed reconciliation schedules and supporting documentation. Knowledge of tenant audit processes and documentation requirements. 
 
 Core Competencies 
 Strategic thinking with ability to translate financial data into business insights. Results-oriented with focus on driving portfolio performance and maximizing recoveries. Strong problem-solving abilities and capacity to resolve complex billing issues. Collaborative approach with ability to work effectively across departments. Detail-oriented with commitment to accuracy in financial reporting and tenant billing. Customer service mindset when dealing with tenant inquiries and concerns. Adaptability to changing business needs, lease requirements, and regulatory standards. 
 
 Working Conditions 
 Office-based role with potential for hybrid arrangements. May require occasional property site visits. Peak workload during month-end close, annual budgeting, and CAM reconciliation season. 
 
 Reporting Structure 
 This role typically reports to a Director of Finance, Portfolio Controller, or Senior Finance Manager and plays a critical function in bridging financial management with property operations to maximize asset value, ensure accurate tenant billing, and optimize expense recoveries. ;

title: Accounts Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities 
 Handle day-to-day accounting activities and maintain accurate financial records. Record and maintain accounting transactions, including purchase, sales, receipt, payment, and journal entries in Tally ERP/Tally Prime. Maintain and update general ledgers, vendor ledgers, customer ledgers, and other accounting records. Manage Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) , including tracking outstanding payments and receivables. Perform bank entries, bank reconciliation, and verification of bank transactions. Conduct vendor and customer account reconciliation and resolve discrepancies. Assist in the preparation and verification of invoices, bills, payment vouchers, receipts, and supporting documents. Assist in GST-related activities, including invoice verification, input tax credit documentation, and basic GST compliance. Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and timely completion of routine accounting activities. Support the finance team during monthly closing, audit preparation, and other accounting-related activities. Required Skills and Competencies 
 Strong hands-on knowledge of Tally ERP / Tally Prime . Good understanding of accounting principles, debit and credit entries, and ledger maintenance. Practical knowledge of AP/AR, bank entries, journal entries, and reconciliations. Basic understanding of GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory accounting requirements. Good working knowledge of MS Excel, including formulas, data sorting, filtering, and report preparation. Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Good attention to detail and accuracy in financial record-keeping. Ability to manage multiple accounting tasks and meet deadlines. Good communication and coordination skills.

title: Manager/ Senior Manager- Finance & Accounts
description:
Job Purpose / Summary   The Manager / Senior Manager – Finance & Accounts is responsible for the accurate, timely and compliant execution of core finance operations — including month-end close, reconciliations, taxation, and accounts payable/receivable — for their area of responsibility. This is a hands-on leadership role: the incumbent supervises a team of accountants and finance executives, ensures day-to-day processes run smoothly and controls are consistently followed, and provides the leadership team with reliable, well-supported financial information. Working closely with the GM – Finance & Accounts, the role holder translates group finance policy into consistent day-to-day practice, resolves operational issues as they arise, and drives continuous improvement in accuracy, compliance and efficiency. The ideal candidate is a qualified accountant (CA/CPA) with strong, hands-on experience across core accounting functions, who is equally comfortable managing a team and staying close to the detail. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Financial Reporting & Accounting 
  Execute the month-end, quarter-end and year-end close process for assigned entities/functions, meeting agreed deadlines and accuracy standards.
 Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments, provisions and intercompany postings ahead of GM sign-off.
 Perform monthly balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring open items are aged, tracked and resolved in a timely manner.
 Prepare accurate P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statements with supporting schedules for management review.
 Support the GM – Finance & Accounts in preparing leadership and management reporting packs.
 Ensure accounting entries and documentation comply with applicable accounting standards and group policy. 
 Budgeting & Forecasting 
 Support the annual budgeting and periodic reforecasting process, coordinating inputs from department and cost-centre owners.
 Prepare monthly budget-vs-actual and forecast-vs-actual variance reports, with clear root-cause commentary.
 Track key financial and operational metrics, flagging risks, cost overruns and opportunities to the GM in a timely manner.
 Assist with cash flow monitoring and working capital tracking, escalating funding requirements as needed.

 Taxation & Compliance 
 Manage timely preparation, review and filing of direct and indirect tax returns (income tax, GST/VAT, TDS/withholding tax) in coordination with external advisors.
 Ensure accurate tax provisioning, reconciliation of tax accounts, and maintenance of supporting documentation.
 Support statutory and regulatory compliance activity, including statutory filings, registers and the compliance calendar.
 Respond to routine tax queries, notices and audit requests, escalating complex matters to the GM/CFO.
 Stay current on changes in tax and regulatory requirements relevant to the entity's operations.

 Accounts Payable & Receivable 
 Oversee end-to-end AP operations — vendor invoice processing, three-way matching, approvals and payment runs — ensuring adherence to delegated authority.
 Oversee AR operations including invoicing, collections and cash application, driving improvement in DSO and reduction of overdue balances.
 Maintain accurate AP/AR ageing and ensure timely resolution of reconciling items and disputes.
 Monitor vendor and customer master data integrity, including controls over changes to banking details.

 Audit & Internal Controls 
 Coordinate with statutory and internal auditors — preparing schedules, responding to queries and closing out action points on time.
 Support the GM in maintaining and testing internal controls, the risk and controls matrix, and segregation of duties.
 Ensure a clean, well-documented audit trail from source data through to reported results.
 Identify and remediate control gaps within own area of responsibility, escalating systemic issues to the GM.

 Team Management & Process Improvement 
 Supervise, coach and develop a team of accountants/finance executives, setting clear priorities and reviewing quality of output.
 Allocate work, monitor performance and build team capability to support growing business needs.
 Drive standardisation, automation and continuous improvement of finance processes and SOPs.
 Ensure finance policies and procedures are correctly understood and consistently applied across the team.
 Act as a key point of contact for cross-functional stakeholders on day-to-day finance matters.

 Key Skills & Competencies 

 Technical Skills 
 Strong working knowledge of accounting standards and their practical application.
 Hands-on experience with month-end close, reconciliations and financial statement preparation.
 Working knowledge of direct and indirect taxation and statutory compliance requirements.
 Proficiency with ERP/accounting systems and advanced Excel; exposure to BI/reporting tools is an advantage.
 Sound understanding of internal controls, audit processes and revenue/cost reconciliation.

 Soft Skills & Behavioural Competencies 
 Strong people management and coaching skills, with the ability to lead and develop a small-to-mid-sized team.
 High attention to detail and accuracy, with a structured, process-driven approach to work.
 A strong ownership mindset and the ability to work independently within defined policy.
 Effective communicator, able to explain financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
 Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growing organisation with evolving processes.
 Sound judgement in escalating issues to senior management at the right time.

 Qualifications & Experience 

 MANDATORY PREREQUISITE – NON-NEGOTIABLE 
Candidates must hold a Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification. This is a strict must-have for this role — applications without CA/CPA qualification will not be considered.

 Required Qualifications 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) — mandatory (see prerequisite above).

 Experience

 Demonstrated experience supervising and developing a finance team.

 Prior experience in a multi-entity, fast-growing, or dynamic organisation is preferred.

This is a dual-focus role covering UK statutory audits and preparation of year-end financial statements under FRS 102 / FRS 105. The ideal candidate will have hands-on exposure to UK audit methodology, strong technical accounting knowledge, and the ability to take ownership of sections of an audit file and a set of year-end accounts from planning through to completion. Working from our Pitampura, Delhi office as part of an international cross-border team. Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 Statutory Audit (UK GAAP / ISA (UK)): Execute planning, fieldwork, and completion procedures on UK statutory audits under ISA (UK) , working under the direction of UK-based managers and the Responsible Individual (RI). Prepare audit working papers on areas such as revenue, purchases, payroll, fixed assets, cash & bank, debtors, creditors, accruals, prepayments, and related party transactions. Perform risk assessment, walkthroughs, tests of controls, substantive analytical procedures, and detailed substantive testing with appropriate sampling. Draft and refine audit file sections on CaseWare, Mercia, IRIS, or similar audit software, ensuring documentation meets ISA (UK) evidence and cross-referencing standards. Identify and escalate audit issues, control weaknesses, misstatements, and potential adjusting journal entries; draft management letter points. Support completion procedures analytical review, going concern assessment, subsequent events, and management representation letters. 
 Year-End Accounts Preparation: Prepare statutory financial statements for UK limited companies under FRS 102 (including Section 1A) and FRS 105 , in accordance with the Companies Act 2006. Post year-end adjustments depreciation, accruals, prepayments, deferred/current tax, dividends, directors' loans, corporation tax provisions and roll forward trial balances. Draft primary statements (Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss / Income Statement, Cash Flow where applicable) with supporting notes and required disclosures. Assist in preparing corporation tax computations (CT600) and iXBRL tagging where required, coordinating with the tax team. Reconcile prior-year comparatives, ensure consistency with statutory filings, and prepare files for RI/manager review.
